cover_letter.greeting: Dear Citi Corporate and Leveraged Finance Underwriting Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the 2027 Full-Time Analyst role in Credit Underwriting on the Corporate and Leveraged Finance Underwriting team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli graduating in spring 2027, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Credit approval for episodic transactions plus ongoing monitoring of the portfolio is a good way to learn how a bank decides which risks it is willing to take, and that is why this team stands out to me.

In my MBA I analyzed financial statements and disclosures to assess earnings quality across firms, and built a DCF and an LBO for J.M. Smucker. At Lenovo I spent two years building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at Thomson Reuters I managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of inflows and reached 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting.

That maps to spreading financials, building models and helping monitor credits. I'd be learning credit underwriting on the job, and I'd bring careful analysis and steady attention to detail. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the program.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli graduating in 2027 and I'm applying for Citi's 2027 Credit Underwriting Analyst role. At Lenovo I built forecasts that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and in my MBA I built a DCF and LBO for J.M. Smucker. I'd love to hear what the first year on the CLFU team looks like. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
